timestampPolicy: New entries receive the current hub arrival time. Existing arrival dates are preserved. Original dates are only set from explicit source dates or dated artifacts; unknown dates remain unset in catalog metadata.
attributionPolicy: Owner confirmed CC55 = Claude Opus 5.5 with explicit per-game exceptions. Stormwing uses its Sonnet 5.5 README; Ashvale uses haiku55; Dustwake explicitly declares GPT-5.6 Sol Pro; Hollowbell model remains unknown. Frostline retains the exact prior Grok 4.7 Build attribution because its installed artifact is identical.
sourceHandling: Only chosen runtime bundles are published. ZIPs, source trees, game-design documents, templates, tests and duplicate exports remain at their source. The differently named Iron Frost runtime inside lucid-loop-source is included separately.

packaging.notes: Original embedded engines and gameplay are retained. The original Three.js r128 CDN script is vendored with its license. Greywater/Urethane worker cleanup is restricted to each game’s own cache prefix.
